columns.Description (SPA): ADVERTENCIA: para obtener el total de votos emitidos de una eleccion NO uses SUM(votes) ni COUNT(*) directamente sobre esta tabla.
columns.Description (ENG): WARNING: to get total votes cast for an election, do NOT use SUM(votes) or COUNT(*) directly on this table.
columns.Values / Domain: See Notes column for the correct query pattern.
columns.Notes: COUNT(*) returns the number of (casilla, party) rows, not votes. SUM(votes) undercounts by 2-4.6% because it excludes num_votos_nulos and num_votos_can_nreg. Those two columns are aggregate-per-casilla values repeated on every party_key row for that casilla, so summing them directly overcounts by ~8-10x (once per party). Correct pattern: first GROUP BY (election_id, casilla_id) taking SUM(votes) as party_votes and MAX(num_votos_nulos), MAX(num_votos_can_nreg) to collapse the per-casilla duplication, THEN sum party_votes + nulos + can_nreg across casillas. Verified against official INE/Wikipedia totals for PRE_2006, PRE_2018, PRE_2024 (exact match) and PRE_2000 (within 0.004%).

rawMeta.important_information: The file begins with sep=| and summary rows before the data header. CLAVE_CASILLA can duplicate, so CLAVE_ACTA is used as the acta-level source key. Coalition columns contain hyphens in raw form and are normalized to underscores in clean outputs.
